twitter_thread: Most AI test generators produce generic output that requires a full rewrite before it's useful. TestFiesta's AI generation works differently. Here's why. 🧵

The problem isn't the AI. It's the context. Generic AI test generators receive a feature description and nothing else. They don't know your templates, custom fields, shared steps, or existing test cases.
TestFiesta's AI reads your full project context before generating: template fields, shared steps library, tag taxonomy, existing test cases. The output fits your test suite.

Multi-generate: describe 5 scenarios in one prompt, get 5 complete test cases — each with correct template fields, shared step references, and tags. What takes 30-45 minutes manually takes 2-3 minutes.

The right mental model: AI handles the production work of translating a known scenario into a structured test case. You handle the strategic work of deciding which scenarios matter. Full guide: testfiesta.com/blog/ai-test-case-generation
